title: Home Inspection Completion Report
subtitle: Home Condition Inspection: verifies results and open follow-up.
description: Home Inspection Completion Report covers visible building system, component, room, exterior area, and reported concern. The home inspection coordinator records Home Condition Inspection performed work, tests, limits, and acceptance. Home Inspection Completion Report keeps Home Condition Inspection exceptions visible until the home inspection coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Home Inspection Completion Report at residence exterior, interior, accessible attic, visible foundation, and installed systems. Document visible building system, component, room, exterior area, and reported concern identity before Home Condition Inspection begins. Compare visible building system, component, room, exterior area, and reported concern findings with stated Home Condition Inspection criteria; route unresolved Home Condition Inspection issues to qualified home-condition reviewer. For Home Inspection Completion Report, confirm requirements for Home Condition Inspection. Ask qualified home-condition reviewer to review Home Condition Inspection conditions beyond the home inspection coordinator's role.

sections.title: Completed-scope context and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Home Condition Inspection, identify responsible parties, residence exterior, interior, accessible attic, visible foundation, and installed systems, and the linked visible building system, component, room, exterior area, and reported concern source.

fields.label: Occupancy, weather, utilities, and access status
System age or identifier when visible

sections.title: Delivered result and verification evidence
sections.guidance: Capture Home Condition Inspection facts for visible building system, component, room, exterior area, and reported concern; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Home Condition Inspection completion checks
items: Site drainage, exterior, roof, and visible structure
Interior rooms, windows, doors, stairs, and finishes
Electrical, plumbing, heating, cooling, and installed equipment
Attic, insulation, ventilation, and moisture indication
Visible foundation, crawlspace, basement, and drainage
Limitations, inaccessible areas, and specialist referral triggers

sections.title: Remaining work, evidence, and next owner
sections.guidance: Resolve open Home Condition Inspection conditions; have home inspection coordinator assign the next Home Condition Inspection owner and transfer its retained record.

blocks.label: Limitations, open work, and retained evidence
items: Active electrical, fuel, structural, or water hazard
Specialist evaluation or immediate protection needed
Operating observation and measurement where appropriate
blocks.guidance: Pause Home Condition Inspection when a safety hazard, access limitation, active damage, or required specialist escalation remains uncommunicated. Retain the available Home Condition Inspection proof and route unresolved visible building system, component, room, exterior area, and reported concern scope to home inspection coordinator.
